items.title: Lawyers' body announces boycott of court proceedings in Islamabad on Saturday to protest Imaan, Hadi's rearrest
items.description:
ISLAMABAD: The Islamabad Bar Association (IBA) has announced a boycott of court proceedings in the federal capital for Saturday (September 19) to protest the rearrest of human rights lawyer Imaan Zainab Mazari-Hazir and her husband, Hadi Ali Chattha, after the Supreme Court suspended their sentences and ordered their release on bail.

items.title: 5 cops among 16 martyred in blast at Kohat Police Lines, more than 50 injured
items.description:
PESHAWAR: At least 16 people, including five police officials, were martyred on Friday when an explosives-laden vehicle detonated near a mosque in Kohat Police Lines, followed by terrorists storming the compound and attacking police facilities, according to a senior law enforcement official.
Footage aired on television showed citizens gathered next to a building with a collapsed wall, digging through rubble and helping the injured.

items.title: 'Petrol so expensive' that PTI lawmakers arrive at Sindh Assembly on donkey carts in protest
items.description:
KARACHI: PTI lawmakers in Sindh arrived at the provincial assembly on donkey carts — in protest.
